response.sql: WITH sentiment_trans_trader AS (SELECT sf.transref, tr.trdref, t.tradekind, sf.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), per_combination_avg AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_trans_trader GROUP BY transref, tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) as baseline_value FROM per_combination_avg), with_deviation AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt, (p.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_value) as deviation FROM per_combination_avg p CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL), type_avg_deviation AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM with_deviation WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_combinations AS (SELECT wd.transref, wd.tradekind, wd.avg_optvolrt, wd.deviation, (wd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation) as excess FROM with_deviation wd INNER JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON wd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE wd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation), final_report AS (SELECT fc.tradekind, AVG(fc.avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt_kept, AVG(fc.deviation) as avg_deviation_kept, AVG(fc.excess) as avg_excess_kept FROM filtered_combinations fc GROUP BY fc.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt_kept, avg_deviation_kept, avg_excess_kept FROM final_report ORDER BY tradekind
